ei.title: Chapter 3-09: Environmental Stress and Genetic Selection
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to survive in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can (A)[adapt / struggle] rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic (B)[uniformity / diversity] are more likely to survive in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less (C)[powerful / effective].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 개체군이 빠르게 적응하고, 유전적 다양성이 있으며, 살충제가 덜 효과적이 된다.

✅ ② adapt — diversity — effective — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ adapt — uniformity — effective (B 반대: 다양성→균일성)
❌ ④ adapt — diversity — powerful (C 유사: 효과적→강력한이나 원문은 effective)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 특정 변이를 선호하고, 독소에 더 내성이 강한 개체를 선택하며, 유전적 다양성을 감소시킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① neglecting — tolerant — reduce (A 반대: 선호하다→무시하다)
❌ ② favoring — sensitive — reduce (B 반대: 내성→민감한)
❌ ③ favoring — tolerant — increase (C 반대: 감소→증가)

It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to (A)[perish / survive] in the face of change. However, there is another side of this (B)[phenomenon / theory] related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to (C)[lose / develop] tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 변화에 직면해 생존하고, 이 현상의 다른 측면이 있으며, 내성을 발달시킨다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① survive — phenomenon — develop — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② perish — phenomenon — develop (A 반대: 생존→멸망)
❌ ③ survive — theory — develop (B 반대: 현상→이론)
❌ ④ survive — phenomenon — lose (C 반대: 발달시키다→잃다)

questions.passage: Environmental ①<u>stresses</u> cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can ②<u>adapt</u> rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to ③<u>perish</u> in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more ④<u>tolerant</u> of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 환경 스트레스, 빠르게 적응, 생존(→멸망), 내성이 강한.
det.analysis:
① <u>stresses</u> (스트레스/압박) — 환경 스트레스가 유전적 변화를 일으킨다는 맥락에 적절
② <u>adapt</u> (적응하다) — 개체군이 환경 변화에 빠르게 적응한다는 맥락에 적절
③ <u>perish</u> (멸망하다) — 원문은 survive(생존하다). 유전적 다양성이 있는 개체군이 생존할 가능성이 더 높다는 맥락에서 perish는 부적절 ←정답
④ <u>tolerant</u> (내성이 있는) — 독소에 더 내성이 강한 개체를 선택한다는 맥락에 적절

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by ①<u>favoring</u> certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being ②<u>forbidden</u> to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to survive in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can ③<u>reduce</u> the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less ④<u>effective</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 선호하며, 필요한(→금지된), 감소시키다, 효과적인.
det.analysis:
① <u>favoring</u> (선호하는) — 특정 유전자 변이를 선호한다는 맥락에 적절
② <u>forbidden</u> (금지된) — 원문은 required(필요한). 돌연변이가 필요 없이 적응할 수 있다는 맥락에서 forbidden은 부적절 ←정답
③ <u>reduce</u> (감소시키다) — 유전적 다양성을 감소시킬 수 있다는 맥락에 적절
④ <u>effective</u> (효과적인) — 살충제가 덜 효과적이 된다는 맥락에 적절

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause ①<u>changes</u> in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic ②<u>diversity</u> are more likely to survive in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection ③<u>pressure</u> for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to ④<u>eliminate</u> tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 변화, 다양성, 압력, 발달시키다(→제거하다).
det.analysis:
① <u>changes</u> (변화) — 유전적 구성에 변화를 일으킨다는 맥락에 적절
② <u>diversity</u> (다양성) — 유전적 다양성이 생존에 중요하다는 맥락에 적절
③ <u>pressure</u> (압력) — 선택 압력을 만든다는 맥락에 적절
④ <u>eliminate</u> (제거하다) — 원문은 develop(발달시키다). 개체군이 독소에 대한 내성을 '발달시킨다'는 맥락에서 eliminate는 부적절 ←정답

det.korean: 개체군이 환경 변화에 빠르게 적응할 수 있다.

❌ ② resist (저항하다) — 적응이 아닌 저항. 변화에 맞서는 것이 아닌 적응하는 것

det.korean: 독소에 더 내성이 강한 개체를 선택한다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② aware (인지하는) — 독소를 인지하는 것이 아닌 견디는 것
✅ ③ tolerant (내성이 있는) — 독소에 더 강한 내성을 가진 개체가 선택된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ suspicious (의심하는) — 독소에 대한 의심은 맥락에 맞지 않음

det.korean: 살충제가 덜 효과적이 된다.
det.analysis:

✅ ② effective (효과적인) — 내성이 발달하면서 살충제가 덜 효과적이 된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ expensive (비싼) — 가격이 아닌 효과에 대한 이야기

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 adapt와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 환경 변화에 빠르게 '적응하다'.

❌ ③ maintain (유지하다) — 감소가 아닌 유지

det.korean: 또 다른 문제가 '발생하다'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① vanishes (사라지다) — occurs의 반의어 방향
❌ ② ceases (멈추다) — 발생이 아닌 중단
✅ ③ happens (발생하다) — occurs의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ④ resolves (해결되다) — 발생이 아닌 해결
det.tip: occurs = happens = arises = takes place. 모두 '발생하다'

❌ ③ useful (유용한) — effective와 유사한 의미

det.tip: effective(효과적인) ↔ futile(헛된, 무익한). ineffective는 접두사 반의어로 출제 금지

questions.passage:
(A) It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to survive in the <u>face</u> of change.
(B) She recognized the familiar <u>face</u> in the crowd immediately.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 face가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 변화에 '직면하여' 생존한다. (B) 군중 속에서 익숙한 '얼굴'을 알아봤다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 직면 — 얼굴: (A) in the face of = ~에 직면하여. face는 '맞닥뜨림/직면'의 의미. (B) face = 얼굴. 사람의 얼굴을 알아보는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② 얼굴 — 직면: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ 표면 — 방향: 두 문맥 모두 해당하지 않음
❌ ④ 방향 — 표면: 두 문맥 모두 해당하지 않음
det.tip: face: ① 얼굴 ② 직면(in the face of) ③ 표면(the face of a clock) ④ 동사 '직면하다'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a substance used for destroying insects or other organisms harmful to cultivated plants"

det.korean: 재배 식물에 해로운 곤충이나 유기체를 죽이는 데 사용되는 물질.
det.analysis:
❌ ① fertilizer (비료) — 해충 제거가 아닌 식물 성장 촉진
❌ ② herbicide (제초제) — 잡초 제거용. 곤충/유기체 대상이 아님
✅ ③ pesticide (살충제) — 해충(pest)을 죽이는 약품. 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ antibiotic (항생제) — 세균 치료용. 해충/식물 맥락이 아님

questions.passage: This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being __________ (require) to produce new adaptations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 돌연변이가 필요 없이 적응할 수 있다.
det.analysis: require → required (과거분사 변환). 'being + p.p.' 수동태 구문. 'without mutations being required' = 돌연변이가 요구되지 않고. being 뒤에 과거분사가 와서 수동태 동명사구를 완성.
det.tip: being + p.p. = 수동 동명사구. require → required (수동태)

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by __________ (favor) certain gene variants more than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 특정 유전자 변이를 더 선호함으로써 변화를 일으킨다.
det.analysis: favor → favoring (동명사 변환). 'by + V-ing' = '~함으로써'. 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사가 와서 수단/방법을 나타냄. favoring = 선호함으로써.
det.tip: by + V-ing = ~함으로써. 전치사 뒤에 동명사가 오는 패턴

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to survive __________ change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. As a result of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 변화에 '직면하여' 생존할 가능성이 더 높다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① in spite of (~에도 불구하고) — 양보가 아닌 직면의 맥락. 변화와 맞서 생존한다는 의미
✅ ② in the face of (~에 직면하여) — 환경 변화에 직면했을 때 유전적 다양성이 생존에 도움이 된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ in terms of (~의 관점에서) — 관점이 아닌 상황 직면
❌ ④ in place of (~대신에) — 대체가 아닌 직면
det.tip: in the face of = when confronted with. ~에 직면하여, ~에 맞서

questions.passage: Environmental stresses cause changes in the genetic makeup of a population by favoring certain gene variants more than others. This is, in fact, the normal way that populations can adapt rapidly to changes in their environment without mutations being required to produce new adaptations. It is also the reason why populations with genetic diversity are more likely to survive in the face of change. However, there is another side of this phenomenon related to human impacts on populations. Toxins added to the environment create selection pressure for individuals that are more tolerant of the toxins. One negative impact of this is that it can reduce the genetic diversity of a population. Another problem occurs if the organism is a pest and the toxin is contained in, for example, a pesticide. __________ of the selection pressure, the population seems to develop tolerance to the toxin. The pesticide then becomes less effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선택 압력의 '결과로' 내성을 발달시키는 것처럼 보인다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① In spite (~에도 불구하고) — 양보가 아닌 인과관계. 'In spite of the selection pressure' 뒤에 내성 발달이면 의미 모순
❌ ② In terms (~의 관점에서) — 관점이 아닌 결과를 설명하는 맥락
❌ ③ On behalf (~를 대신하여) — 대리가 아닌 인과관계
✅ ④ As a result (~의 결과로) — 선택 압력 → 내성 발달이라는 인과 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: As a result of ~ = ~의 결과로. 인과관계를 나타내는 표현
